notes.title: Jan 20 Patch: Multi-Language Support Added
notes.content:
🎉 Update: Multiple Interface Languages Now Supported! 🌍

We're excited to announce that our app now supports multiple interface languages! 🎌🌐 You can easily switch between languages via the Steam app settings.

This update is part of our commitment to making the app more accessible and enjoyable for users worldwide. 🌟

Thank you for your support, and happy gaming!
